claims: The "No Kings" protests are a nationwide, nonviolent movement in the U.S.
The "No Kings" protests are organized by the 50501 Movement.
The "No Kings" rallies have been held over 3,300 times in 50 states.
The 50501 Movement stands for 50 states, 50 protests, and one united movement.
The "No Kings" movement lacks a single demand.
The "No Kings" movement gained momentum following the fatal shooting of protesters by federal immigration agents in Minneapolis.
The "No Kings" movement gained momentum following a significant increase in federal agent activity.
The "No Kings" movement gained momentum following an unpopular war with Iran.
Protesters have used the "No Kings" protests to call for a "dethroning" of what they term a king-like president and his allies.
